note: Every product below was priced against the endpoint. Unknown codes are rejected with CBC.6006.

ecs.description: Elastic Cloud Server, Linux image. Spec is the flavor name shown in the console.

evs.description: Elastic Volume Service. Specs seen to work: SAS, SSD, GPSSD. Priced per GB.

rds-postgresql.description: RDS for PostgreSQL instance. A spec ending in .ha is the primary/standby version. The disk is priced separately (see pending).

cce-cluster.description: CCE cluster management fee. cce.s1.* has one control plane node, cce.s2.* has three. Worker nodes are ECS.

eip.description: Elastic IP address itself. Spec 5_bgp. The IP costs nothing; bandwidth or traffic is billed separately (see pending).
